author: Zedther
body:
Hey, so, I was wondering..
Why are people banned for having excessive infractions?
what is the ammount of which people do get "banned"
do you not get banned, if the infractions occur over a long period of time?
Coz I've seen some users with many infractions
such as http://avicus.net/Da_Baus?tab=infractions
Not saying for you to ban, just asking what exactly goes on?

title: Excessive infractions

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Depends on his/her offense.
For example: A player that had been warned/kicked 5+ Times is diffrent from a player with 5+ Temp's/kicks. They are going to get a longer punishment for his/her offense.

Da_Blues.has been punished for several reasons, and has Not been breaking the same rule over and over. Yet people do make mistakes, He is mature and respectful in-game. He will not be punished. Thanks for your concern! Have a wonderful day. Take care!
